---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to accomplish? What does the current code make hard or impossible?

## Proposed solution

A clear, concise description of what you'd like to see. If you have an implementation sketch, include it.

## Affected component(s)

Which app or package would change: `chat-api` / `chat-frontend` / `controller` / `pi-harness` / `rag-api/api` / `rag-api/ingest` / `packages/shell` / cross-cutting.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why they don't fit.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art in other projects, or design notes.
